# Vendored files

From the VS Code Lean 4 extension, [vscode-lean4](https://github.com/leanprover/vscode-lean4)
v0.0.225 (Apache-2.0), as shipped in lean4monaco 1.1.16:

- `lean4.json`, `lean4-markdown.json` — TextMate grammars (`source.lean4`, `source.lean4.markdown`)
- `language-configuration.json` — brackets, comments, auto-closing pairs

`JuliaMono-Regular.ttf` — [JuliaMono](https://github.com/cormullion/juliamono) (SIL OFL 1.1),
the editor font lean4monaco used.
